fissure.criterion: two opposite superbase-edge wall coefficients vanish at a reduced hyperboloid point
fissure.field_boundary_continuation: if no reduced crossing occurs on the current branch, continue from wall x through the fissure on opposite wall opp(x)

crossing.criterion: two adjacent superbase-edge wall coefficients vanish at a reduced hyperboloid point

branch_order_rule.from_crossing_xy_following_x: test the three other walls adjacent to x (excluding y) for reduced crossings on the same branch; the consecutive one is followed first
branch_order_rule.fallback: if none exists on that branch, x terminates at fissure (x,opp(x)) and the boundary continues on opp(x)
branch_order_rule.two_crossing_simplification: when exactly two crossing points lie on wall x, Selling permits treating them as if they belonged to the same branch for field grouping
branch_order_rule.closure_guard: the final boundary line of a field must reconnect to its first; otherwise the field is not serialized as historical

standard_h_branch_discriminator.case_B_pos_a_c_neg: two branches; distinguish by the signs of xi and zeta
standard_h_branch_discriminator.case_B_a_c_neg: two parts; distinguish by the sign of adjoint H
standard_h_branch_discriminator.other_cases: NT/FAIL-CLOSED until transformed to a certified standard marking

exact_fissure_test.accept: all six reduction inequalities hold exactly
